title: An XLM SAC transfer to a muxed address: the event splits it into to and to_muxed_id
pattern: The transfer argument is M(bob, 2^64-1). The event names bob's G address in topics and carries the ID as to_muxed_id (u64) in a data map instead of a bare i128.

hazards.placement: transfer event data map with to_muxed_id u64
event splits M into to and to_muxed_id

facts.says: The event names bob's base account.
The data is a map with amount 1 and to_muxed_id 18446744073709551615.
